_about: Public-domain Louis Albert Banks (1855-1933), Methodist Episcopal preacher and evangelist, for the Word Hoard: his books of sermons, revival sermons, prayer-meeting talks and illustrations printed 1892-1925, among them The People's Christ (1892), the 'and His Friends' revival series (1895-1907), Windows for Sermons (1902), Sermons which have Won Souls (1908), The Great Themes of the Bible (1911) and Christ's Soul-Searching Parables (1925), with Immortal Hymns and their Story (1897) and his life of T. DeWitt Talmage (1902). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 76 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
